details: On October 24, 2026, the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) finalized rules implementing the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for US Stablecoins (GENIUS) Act. This requires OCC-supervised banks to hold 1:1 high-quality liquid asset reserves for stablecoins, obtain prior OCC approval for issuance or custody, and adopt stringent liquidity and risk management standards. This move is set to reshape crypto compliance for banks and businesses utilizing stablecoins.
title: OCC Finalizes Stablecoin Rules, Impacting Crypto Compliance for Banks

details: Bitcoin is struggling to maintain the $80,000 support level, with analysts suggesting a weekly close below $83,000 on October 25, 2026, could signal further bearish sentiment for the rest of the year. This comes ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting (October 27-28) and the release of September inflation data (October 29). Geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and weakened institutional flows are contributing to market volatility, with corporate holders facing potential losses if prices fall further.
title: Bitcoin Tests $80K Support as Macroeconomic Uncertainties Mount

details: As of October 24, 2026, with US consumer prices increasing by 3.7% through September, gold has significantly outperformed Bitcoin as an inflation hedge over a five-year period, with gold surging 126% compared to Bitcoin's 28% gain. In the last year, Bitcoin's value has plummeted by 27.4% despite rising inflation. The report highlights that central banks are actively stockpiling gold, a demand Bitcoin currently lacks.
title: Gold Beats Bitcoin as Inflation Hedge, BTC Suffers 27% Annual Decline

details: The Federal Reserve's meeting on October 28 and the European Central Bank's meeting on October 29, 2026, are anticipated to be major market-moving events. The decisions on interest rates, particularly the Fed's potential pause after recent signals and the ECB's review of euro area rates (currently 2.50% deposit facility), will significantly influence currency markets, precious metals, and speculative assets like Bitcoin. Unexpectedly hawkish stances from either central bank could exert further downward pressure on cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed & ECB Meetings This Week: Key for Crypto Market Direction
